metadata.name: GetEmbossingDetails
metadata.description: This API is used to transfer the embossing details to the client on request.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin number is a unique identifier of card in the system ,returned in the response of Account creation. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber is required.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Cardholder Account number. Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Admin number is a unique identifier of card in the system ,returned in the response of Account creation. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Card Number of cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Example: 2

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Date on which card will expire. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMYY Example:0121 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example: John J Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Title
children.description: Title of the cardholder. Format: A-Z Example: Mr Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Cardholder First name. Valid Values:A-Z Example:User1 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MiddleName
children.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values:A-Z Example: LEE Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastName
children.description: Cardholder last name. Valid Values:A-Z Example:Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressLine1
children.description: Cardholder address line 1. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressLine2
children.description: Cardholder address line 2. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Park Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: City
children.description: This tag reflects the City name of the cardholder address. Example:Los Angeles Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

children.name: State
children.description: State of cardholder address Valid Values: a-z Format:XXX Example:MO Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

children.name: PostalCode
children.description: Postal code of the cardholder address. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:46206 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

children.name: Country
children.description: Country name of the cardholder address Example:USA Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

children.name: CompanyName
children.description: Company Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example: Company LLC Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

children.name: CreditLimit
children.description: Credit Limit of account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: CashLimit
children.description: CashLimit Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: CVC
children.description: 3 digit number used in certain transactions. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:018 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: CVV2
children.description: 3 digit number used in transaction and printed on back of the card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:788 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: iCVV
children.description: 3 digit security number used in some transactions. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:285 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: PIN
children.description: Personal Identification Number of Card Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:2014 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: PinOffset
children.description: PinOffset Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:2014 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: Track1Data
children.description: Track1Data Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format:XXXX Example:B5288981432934738^LAST/FIRST^22012010101839350000000000 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: Track2Data
children.description: Track2Data Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format:XXXX Example:5288981432934738=22012010101839350000 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: Track2EquivalentData
children.description: Track2EquivalentData Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format:XXXX Example:5288981432934738=22012010100039350000 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: ActivationCode
children.description: Code which is provided at the time of Account Creation/Registration, should be passed as a user validation. Example: 123456 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded.Response ID is unique.This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Valid Values:0-9,a-z Format:xxx Example:200 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: Track1DiscretionaryData
children.description: Track1 Discretionary Data Example:0152624720000000000 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: EmbossingLine4
children.description: Embossing Line4 Valid Values:A-Z Example:ABC Allowable Values: 20
